primary_findings: Exp5 is the strongest currently verifiable recipe, but it does not establish single-module causality.
SGA is genuinely wired into forward, optimization and checkpoints, but its preregistered screening gate failed.
P4.1 soft-boundary underperformed legacy G2 and should not advance.
L0 supports semantic granularity mismatch, while L1A failed its primary E5 gate and lacks inference-time instance semantics.
Validation aggregation and train/full-test protocol differences weaken model-selection comparability.
The current FreqPath is not a literal spectral transform and should not be described as frequency-domain processing.
Core conclusions are single-seed and lack matched multi-seed canonical full-tests.

recommended_next_experiment.name: RSGR-1 Region-Semantic Grounding Randomization
recommended_next_experiment.formal_if_advanced: 4 groups x at least 3 preregistered seeds with canonical full-test
recommended_next_experiment.screening_advance_gate: correct-local vs no-local mAJI >= +0.003, mPQ drop <= 0.002, and correct-local mAJI >= shuffled/random +0.002
recommended_next_experiment.recommended_resources: 2 x 24GB GPUs; approximately 7-10 aggregate GPU-hours for screening based on historical logs

evidence_limitations: Git metadata is absent, so code version and dirty state cannot be established.
Exp6 claimed full-test metrics lack a corresponding formal full-test log.
Phase B and Phase C original formal logs are incomplete.
Most central comparisons are single-seed and validation-only.
Training validation defaults to partial rank-local evaluation without all-reduce.
Training validation and full-test postprocessing settings differ.
